curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Open with open and expansion joints, then intersection, Y, T and roundabout signs, and the curve and turn warnings.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for Y versus T junctions and for single bends versus a winding road.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on joints, junction signs and curve warnings.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the low ground crossing, advance signs, the crossbuck, flashing lights and gates, and the pavement marking.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for crossbuck versus lights versus gates and for one track versus several.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that swaps the crossing devices and what each requires.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover clearing the tracks before starting across, what to do if your car stalls, school buses at crossings and the emergency sign.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for a moving car versus a stalled car and for school buses versus reporting a danger.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on crossing safety and emergencies.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain work zone limits and penalties, rough road and detour signs, arrow boards, flaggers, photo enforcement and channelizing devices.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; the flagger fact rides on the arrow-board, flagger and photo contrast card; a contrast card for the two penalties.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on work zone signs, devices and penalties.
